rules.text: Transitions, entrances and sounds vary across the film; the same join or whoosh on every beat is a note the user already gave (2026-11-17).

rules.text: News films show the researched sources on screen (article captures with the spoken line highlighted, posts, footage) and change their edit per section; no picture repeats without a reason.
